verdict.rationale: Open WebUI keeps a Keep-a-Changelog repository changelog, commits to Semantic Versioning, and publishes per-version plugin-API migration guides for breaking releases, which covers versioned releases, changelogs and some migration notes. Nothing in the evidence documents a repair or rollback path, and the docs warn that the :main container tag can introduce breaking changes without warning. missing for 10: documented rollback/downgrade or repair procedure for failed updates, migration notes beyond the plugin API (e.g. database/config upgrades), independent corroboration that updates are safe in practice.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks
